what: Each letter is painted in one of seven colors and pops up 10~20% above the line (100%) (sideways ±5%, ±5° tilt, .4s power1.out, .02s between letters), then settles in place with bounce.out .5s and returns to its original letter color — a Hero title where a phrase like ”Your color” bounces in rainbow colors and then resolves into the brand color. With keep, the popped color stays.

options.rise: Bounce height range ‹small,large›, default 10,20 — in unit units
options.drift: Maximum sideways shift, default 5 — in unit
options.unit: If ”px”, rise · drift are in px and the start position is in place rather than below the line (subpage title style — tyo uses rise 5,10 · drift 2 · unit px · delay .5). Default is % (ratio of letter height)
options.on: If “enter,” triggers when 80% is in view, if absent, right on load
options.paint: If ”none”, it just bounces without painting
options.keep: If “on”, splashed colors stay (they do not return to the original color)
options.--fx-paint-1 … --fx-paint-7: Seven colors to pick from when bursting — default is a rainbow made by rotating the --kf-accent hue. The user overrides them with their own colors
options.[data-fx-part=line]: (if any) text lines to split — the turns continue line by line. If none, the whole text of the attached element

from.where: index.html .ty-hero__title (Hero English title — after the loader) · .ty-hero__color (keep, while the section is visible) · list.html .ty-lower__title (rise 5,10 · drift 2 · unit px · delay .5)
